title: Design System: Minimal course discovery Preview

motion.name: document-change
motion.purpose: User-triggered document update; opacity .7 to 1 and translateY 3px to 0; disabled under reduced motion.

source.scope: Isolated noindex Preview. Main /, learning and Studio retain existing visual conventions; no migration or global detector rules are implied.
source.ramps: No synthetic tonal ramps: retain existing five selectable accent presets and semantic theme mappings.
source.refinement: Minimal discovery supersedes scene controls and teaching demo. Caption12px, metadata13px, description15px, body16px; 40px maximum hero, 30px course title.
source.composition: Short heading and sentence, actual course and one primary open-course action. No explanatory strip, example, Blog teaser or FAQ. Shared routes remain reachable.

narrative.overview: Minimal discovery Preview: original logo and semantic themes; real course title, concise description and real metadata lead directly to the existing course route. Current DESIGN.md supersedes earlier workbench observations.
keyCharacteristics: Onest for Cyrillic headings, prose and controls.
Five user-selected accents over light, dark or system appearance.
Opaque reading surfaces and a flat instructional workbench.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the active semantic action, text-accent and subtle tokens; the Radix violet prop does not choose the user’s accent.

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: Keep display and body typography on the existing Onest stack; reserve the mono stack for code.

rules.name: The Solid Reading Rule
rules.body: Use the solid surface token beneath document and course reading content. The preview’s source panel remains opaque plum.

dos: Do preserve the existing semantic theme and accent mappings, including all five accents.
Do keep Onest, Cyrillic wrapping, visible focus and reduced-motion behaviour.
Do reuse reviewed course artwork through the web-owned resolver and its provenance record.
donts: Don’t treat this preview as approval to replace `/` or restyle learning and Studio.
Don’t persist the conceptual example’s answer or progress.
Don’t introduce autoplay motion or blurred reading surfaces into this preview.
